capabilities: Plan writing projects with chapters, scenes, characters and locations as Markdown notes
Track characters, locations, objects, events, story arcs, research and relationships
Set word targets and see approximate word counts per scene
Adopt existing vault notes into the project by assigning a type
Export and import project files in the Writeller Exchange 1.0.0 format
extras: Free, no account or Writeller license required, and makes no network, tracking or AI calls. Screenshots are recorded in a browser test host with synthetic data, not native Obsidian; mobile devices are not yet validated. Manual installation from GitHub release ZIP; detailed handbook, FAQ and changelog are on external pages.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for viewing a novel's chapters, scenes and story elements together as one managed writing project.

relations.evidence: enabling manual project exchange between Writeller and this Obsidian plugin

summary: Writing-project planner that organizes chapters, scenes, characters and locations as plain Markdown notes and exchanges projects with the Writeller app.
